protected_existing_split.rule: Exclude every task identifier in old train, validation and TEST, without opening original TEST labels.

selection_rule: Task identifiers must exactly match externally published source names, types list-of-int input to list-of-int or int output; exclude protected prior split names. Select the prespecified families exactly; sorted lexicographically before assignment to 3 rounds. No audit performance inspected.
oracle_reconstruction_contract: Experiment code must implement externally named semantics, compare independently against upstream examples, and abort (not revise) on any mismatch. FRESH shifted inputs are generated with a fixed seed outside the source example distribution. The original test split is never loaded.
raw_upstream_labels_policy: Audit source examples are not accessed until after development selection is frozen; audit selection uses only published task IDs in this preregistered file.
